Successful HWPX manipulation requires handling split XML text nodes and clearing layout caches to ensure correct rendering.
Placeholders like {{key}} are often fragmented across multiple <hp:t> tags, necessitating a regex-based extraction and concatenation strategy. The script must remove <hp:lineSegArray> elements to force the viewer to recalculate text layout and prevent stale cached positions. Specific formatting was applied to '참석자수', '만족도', and '종합의견' fields during the global XML string replacement process.
